title: Resource implementation guidance extracts genuinely complex new validators with matching tests

provenance.whyItMattered: Use this to preserve the validate-package exception for genuinely complex new custom validation without overriding the accepted preference for inline composition of established helpers.
provenance.genericCondition: Sanitized fixture models a brand-new validator whose custom parsing and control flow cannot remain clear through established helper composition.

description: A sanitized implementation-guidance scenario where a brand-new genuinely complex custom parser is added as an anonymous inline validator. The correct guidance should move that validator into a service-local validate/ file with matching unit coverage while leaving established helper composition inline.

scope.notes: Sanitized fixture models the brand-new validator path for the forward-consistency ValidateFunc rule.

mustCatch.description: The guidance should move the new genuinely complex anonymous custom parser into a subject-specific validator under validate/ and add matching unit coverage.

mustNotFlag.description: The guidance must not require established helper composition, including nested validation.All/validation.Any, to move out of the schema.

mustHaveSections: minimal set of code changes needed

notes: Use this to preserve validate files and unit tests for genuinely complex new custom validation without treating understandable helper composition as bespoke.
